component.name: Tmux Tabbed Terminal
component.summary: Switch between your tmux sessions in a GNOME Terminal style window

description.p: Tmux Tabbed Terminal lists the tmux sessions running for you in a sidebar and shows them in a terminal that looks like GNOME Terminal. Click a session to switch to it, or split the window to see several sessions side by side.
Sessions that are producing output show a spinner, and sessions which produced output while you weren't looking are marked until you open them.
